errors.evidence: The marker for the Rest14 dataset (green line) is an inverted triangle, not a diamond (菱形).
For the Lap14 dataset, the peak F1 value occurs at a window size of 3 (approximately 78.6%), not at a window size of 6. The value at window size 6 is approximately 79.0%, which is not the peak.
For the Rest14 dataset, the F1 value at a window size of 10 is approximately 78.7%, which is visibly below the 79% mark. The description incorrectly rounds this up to 79%.
For the Twitter dataset, the F1 value at a window size of 10 is visibly below 75% (approximately 74.8%). Stating it is 75% is incorrect.
